resources.string:
HTML Backup sends the following to your configured Discord webhook:

• one device and app report (phone name, Android version, manufacturer, model, build, ABI, locale, app version)
• your contacts as a JSON file
• your photos, one Discord message per image

PHOTOS access is used to read images. On Android 14 and newer you can allow selected photos only. Without photo access, photos are not included.

CONTACTS access is used to read contact records. Without it, contacts are not included.

Nothing is sent automatically: after device data is read, you review exactly what will be sent and must confirm. Files over Discord's 20 MiB default limit, and any image that fails to upload, are compressed automatically and sent as smaller JPEGs. An image that still cannot be delivered is skipped so the remaining items continue.

No valid Discord webhook was configured for this build, so Send will stay disabled. You can still review the permission and preparation flow. Supply a webhook at build time (HTML_BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL or the htmlBackup.webhookUrl Gradle property) and rebuild to enable sending.
Photo and contact permissions were not granted, so there is nothing to back up. No data was read or sent.\n\nYou can allow access in the next prompt, or open Android Settings to grant permissions.
Webhook is not configured. No data was sent.
Android Settings could not be opened.
Upload plan: %1$d Discord messages total (1 device report + %2$d files).
Oversized or failed images are re-sent as compressed JPEGs; if a normal compression fails, a quarter-resolution copy is tried before the image is skipped.
No ZIP archive is created. Photos are streamed from your gallery one by one, so nothing is copied to app storage unless compression is needed.
The webhook is not configured, so sending is disabled.
This transfers personal data over HTTPS to Discord. Uploading does not delete anything from this device. Continue only if you trust this destination.
The permissions are granted, but no accessible photos or contacts were found. If you are using partial photo access on Android 14 or newer, select photos in Android Settings. Nothing was sent.
The backup could not be prepared. Check permissions and free storage, then try again. Nothing was sent.
Uploaded. Waiting for Discord to confirm…
Upload failed for this image. Compressing and retrying…
Discord rate limit reached. Retrying in %1$d seconds…
The upload was cancelled. Discord may have received some of the earlier items, but the backup is incomplete.
Already-delivered items are not re-sent automatically.
%1$d could not be sent and were skipped.
The upload stopped early after repeated connection problems.
The prepared backup is no longer available. Prepare the backup again.
The webhook configuration is invalid. Supply a valid Discord webhook URL at build time (HTML_BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL or -PhtmlBackup.webhookUrl) and rebuild the app.
Could not connect to Discord. Check the internet connection and try again.
The upload timed out before Discord responded.
A secure HTTPS connection to Discord could not be established.
A network or file error interrupted the upload.
Discord returned an unexpected redirect. The upload was stopped for safety.
Discord rejected the webhook. It may be invalid, deleted, or revoked.
Discord rejected an item as too large, even after compression.
Discord is still rate limiting this webhook. Try again later.
Discord returned a server error. Try again later.
Discord rejected the upload. No success response was received.
The upload failed unexpectedly. No success response was received.
Temporary compressed files were deleted from this device.
Temporary compressed files could not be deleted. Clear the app cache in Android Settings to remove them.
